narrative: You apply pressure with your pick, feeling the hidden teeth shift beneath the heavy iron plate. With a sharp, resonant clack, the final tumbler yields. The massive vault door groans on rusted hinges, swinging inward to expose a spiraling descent into absolute, lightless dark. A stale breath of ancient decay and damp earth exhales from the threshold, chilling the sweat on your neck.

choices.text: Step down into the dark stairwell with your hand on your sword hilt
Call into the lightless opening to test if anything answers
Press your shoulder against the heavy iron door to wedge it open further

extractedMemories.summary: Successfully unlocked the ancient vault door, revealing a lightless stair leading downward.
